component.name: Gemel
component.summary: Synchronize files and directories, as Unison does

description.p: Gemel keeps two replicas of a collection of files and directories in step, on one host or on two, over ssh or a socket. Changes on either side are propagated to the other, and conflicting changes are shown for you to resolve.
It is a Rust port of the Unison file synchronizer, compatible with it: either end can be Unison, and the profiles and archives are the same. Gemel is not an official Unison project.
